info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Process Refunds API
info.description: The Process Refunds API allows merchants to efficiently manage and execute refund transactions for their customers. With this API, users can update the status of a specific refund using its unique identifier. It is designed for use by e-commerce platforms, payment gateways, and customer service applications that need to handle refunds seamlessly. Typical consumers include financial service providers and businesses offering return policies, ensuring a smooth customer experience in transactions involving refunds.

put.description: This endpoint allows you to modify the details of a specific refund identified by its unique ID. You can update various attributes of the refund as needed.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a refund process for the specified refund ID (RES-100045). The body must conform to the defined JSON schema, containing the necessary information and any additional parameters required for processing the refund.
